job.prompt: A single continuous ten-second vertical 9:16 photorealistic home editorial film for Rem Vina. Use this art direction: warm ivory plaster, neutral oat linen drapes, sheer white curtain, a simple cream armchair beside a bright rectangular aluminum window, blurred leafy greenery outdoors. Recompose as a tall portrait frame. The hook in the first second is beautiful sheer cloth catching soft morning light. For the full ten seconds a gentle natural breeze slowly lifts and settles ONLY the loose sheer curtain in a graceful small wave; leafy light shadows drift subtly on the wall. Very slow camera push toward the window, no cuts. Window frame, handle, armchair, floor and room geometry remain completely stable. Calm intimate domestic feeling, realistic fabric motion, not a storm, not surreal. No people, no hands, no text, no logo, no music, no speech, no added decorative objects. Do not animate any net fastening or imply a performance test. Leave top and bottom areas visually quiet for later Vietnamese titles. This is atmospheric campaign illustration, not a product demonstration.
